item.cosmog.true_ade_soul.tooltip: Right-click on the ground to call Ade. She drops it (with her memories) if she falls.
message.cosmog.ade_status: Ade - Affection %s/100 | Health bonus %s/12 | Strength bonus %s/6%s
dialogue.cosmog.ade.summon.1: Hi! I'm Ade~ I'll take care of you, I promise!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.summon.2: Thanks for calling me... I'll do my best!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.summon.3: A new adventure! Where do we start?
dialogue.cosmog.ade.sit.1: I'll sit for a bit~ Tell me when to follow again.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.sit.2: Okay, I'll wait here. Don't be long!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.follow.2: Here I come! I won't get lost.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.lowhp.1: I'm running out of strength... got a golden apple?
dialogue.cosmog.ade.lowhp.2: I need to rest a little...
dialogue.cosmog.ade.lowhp.3: I'm... a bit weak. But I'm still with you.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.combat.3: Stay close, we'll take them down together!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.kill.2: I did it! Did you see?
dialogue.cosmog.ade.ownerhurt.1: Are you okay?! I won't let them hurt you!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.ownerhurt.3: Don't you touch her! I'll handle it.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.gift.1: Is it for me? Thank you, I love it!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.gift.2: What a lovely gift! I'll keep it forever.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.gift_fav.1: This again! I know it's your favorite thing to give me~
dialogue.cosmog.ade.gift_fav.2: My favorite! I've learned how you think.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.gift_fav.3: You always pick right with this one! I know it by heart.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.gift_bored.1: Thanks... though I already have quite a few of these.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.gift_bored.2: Hehe, another one... how about something different?
dialogue.cosmog.ade.gift_bored.3: I like it, but I'm curious about something new.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.golden.2: Thank you! I feel like I can take much more.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.golden_max.1: I can't eat any more, I'm at my limit!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.notch.1: Ah! I feel a huge power... Thank you!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.notch.2: That apple... I got goosebumps! I feel unstoppable.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.notch.3: Wow! My hits are so much stronger now.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.notch_max.1: I've reached my strength limit, that's enough!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.notch_max.2: I can't get any stronger... and I love it!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.notch_max.3: I'm at max. Now I'm your shield and your sword.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.tier25.1: I'm starting to trust you~ I'll look after your wounds.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.tier25.2: I think we're good friends now... I'll heal you when needed!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.tier25.3: I'm getting attached to you, you know?
dialogue.cosmog.ade.tier50.1: You're very important to me. I'll fight harder!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.tier50.2: I feel safe with you. I'll try twice as hard!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.tier50.3: We're a great team, aren't we?
dialogue.cosmog.ade.tier75.1: I care about you so much... I never want anything to happen to you.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.tier75.2: You're my favorite person in all the worlds.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.tier75.3: Whatever happens, I'll be by your side until the end.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.idle_low.2: This place is pretty weird, isn't it?
dialogue.cosmog.ade.idle_low.3: I'm just following so you don't get lost.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.idle_mid.1: You know? I like walking with you.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.idle_mid.3: Do you think I'll have my own home someday?
dialogue.cosmog.ade.idle_high.1: Can I tell you a secret? You're the best thing that ever happened to me.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.idle_high.2: Look! I made a new bow... do you like it?
dialogue.cosmog.ade.idle_high.3: With you, even the dark scares me less.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.umbra.1: This place... gives me chills. Stay close, please.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.umbra.2: I feel like something is watching us... don't wander off!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.umbra.3: The lights flicker... I don't like this at all.
dialogue.cosmog.ade.cosmog.1: The sky looks so pretty! Like a dream~
dialogue.cosmog.ade.cosmog.2: Everything is so calm here... I love it!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.cosmog.3: Look at those stars... they're huge!
dialogue.cosmog.ade.overworld.3: It smells like grass here. I like it!
